|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Use 1 Force: ▼(or retrieve from Lost Pile) Leia, Leia's Blaster Rifle, or Leia's Sporting Blaster. OR Use 2 Force to add 2 to a Force drain where Leia is present.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Leia's Back (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) Leia’s Blaster Rifle, Leia’s Sporting Blaster, or Leia from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you just initiated a Force drain where Leia is present, use 2 Force to make that Force drain +2.” '''What changed:''' “Force: ▼(or retrieve from Lost Pile) Leia, Leia's” → “Force to deploy (or retrieve) Leia’s”; added “Leia’s Sporting Blaster,”; “Leia's Sporting Blaster.” → “Leia from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “Use 2 Force to add 2 to” → “If you just initiated”; “present.” → “present, use 2 Force to make that Force drain +2.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 13. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Leia's Back]].
* Later text: [[Leia's Back (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Leia's Back (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Leia's Back]].
